note: All 10 samas are fully populated and sourced. Original owi text and Marathi meaning from the ioustotra.blogspot.com 'Stotra (hymns)' blog (Prakash Ketkar); English meaning from John Norwell's 2015 translation. Every samas's owi count matches exactly between both independent sources with no gaps, duplicates, or numbering shifts. Samas 1’s title is often given as "आकांक्षा" (Aakaksha, "desire") in the source’s own URL slug, but its colophon and content both confirm the real title is आशंका (Aashanka, "doubt") - the colophon was trusted over the slug. This dashak continues examining doubt, knowingness, inference, the three gunas and form, and the final state of the Self.

source.name: Stotra (hymns) blog by Prakash Ketkar (ioustotra.blogspot.com) — original owi text and Marathi meaning

englishSource.name: Dasbodh, English translation by John Norwell (2015)

owis.original: निराकार म्हणिजे काये। निराधार म्हणिजे काये । निर्विकार म्हणिजे काये । मज निरोपावें ॥ १ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: निराकार, निराधार, निर्विकार म्हणजे काय तें मला सांगावें.
owis.englishMeaning: "Formless means what? Support-less means what? Thoughtless means what? I want to understand that non-dual discourse."

owis.original: निराकार म्हणिजे आकार नाहीं । निराधार म्हणिजे आधार नाहीं । निर्विकार म्हणिजे कल्पना नाहीं । परब्रह्मासी ॥ २ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: परब्रह्माला आकार नाहीं, आधार नाहीं. त्याच्या ठिकाणी कल्पना नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: Formless means no form? Support-less means no support. Thoughtless means there is no thought or concept, and that is parabrahman.

owis.original: निरामय म्हनिजे काये । निराभास म्हणिजे काये । निरावेव म्हणिजे काये । मज निरोपावें ॥ ३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: निरामय, निराभास, निरावेव म्हणजे काय तें मला सांगावें.
owis.englishMeaning: "niramaya means what? Without appearance means what? Without parts means what? To this `me', there should be that discourse."

owis.original: निरामय म्हनिजे जळमये नाहीं । निराभास म्हणिजे भासचि नाहीं । निरावेव म्हणिजे अवेव नाहीं । परब्रह्मासी ॥ ४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आमय म्हणजे रोग, नाश किंवा विकार. रोग हा पिंडाचा विकार तर प्रलयकालीं जलमय होणें हा ब्रह्मांडाचा विकार होय. परब्रह्माला सृष्टीच्या शेवटीं व आधीं हा विकार बाधत नाहीं. म्हणून तें निरामय आहे. परब्रह्माच्या ठिकाणीं भास नाहीं. त्यास आकार नाहीं. म्हणून अवयव नाहींत.
owis.englishMeaning: niramaya means there is no objectification. Without appearance means it has no ap- pearance and without parts means, there are no parts to parabrahman.

owis.original: निःप्रपंच म्हणिजे काये । निःकळंक म्हणिजे काये । निरोपाधी न्हणिजे काये । मज निरोपावें ॥ ५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: निःप्रपंच, निःकलंक, निरुपाधि म्हणजे काय तें मला सांगावें.
owis.englishMeaning: "Without prapanch means what? Without stain means what? Without upadhi means what? To this `me', there should be that non-dual discourse."

owis.original: निःप्रपंच म्हणिजे प्रपंच नाहीं । निःकळंक म्हणिजे कळंक नाहीं । निरोपाधी म्हणिजे उपाधी नाहीं । परब्रह्मासी ॥ ६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: परब्रह्माला संसार नाहीं. कसलाही कलंक नाहीं. व कोणतीही उपाधी किंवा मर्यादा नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: Without prapanch means there are no five elements. Without stain means there is no stain and without limiting concepts means there are no limiting concepts to pa- rabrahman.

owis.original: निरोपम्य म्हणिजे काये । निरालंब म्हणिजे काये । निरापेक्षा म्हणिजे काये । मज निरोपावें ॥ ७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: निरुपम, निरालंब, निरपेक्ष म्हणजे काय तें मला सांगावें.
owis.englishMeaning: "Without comparison means what? Without support means what? Without expectation means what? To this `me', there should be that discourse."

owis.original: निरोपम्य म्हणिजे उपमा नाहीं । निरालंब म्हणिजे अवलंब नाही । निरापेक्षा म्हणिजे अपेक्षा नाहीं । परब्रह्मासी ॥ ८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: परब्रह्माला उपमा नाहीं. तें कशावर अवलंबून नाहीं. त्याला कशाची अपेक्षा नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: Without comparison means it has no equal. Without support means it does not grasp for support. Without expectation means there is no expectation, to parabrahman.

owis.original: निरंजन म्हणिजे काये । निरंतर म्हणिजे काये। निर्गुण म्हणिजे काये । मज निरोपावें ॥ ९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: निरंजन, निरंतर, निर्गुण म्हणजे काय तें मला सांगावें.
owis.englishMeaning: "niranjan means what? nirantar means what? nirgun means what? That should be discoursed to me."

owis.original: निरंजन म्हणिजे जनचि नाहीं । निरंतर म्हणिजे अंतर नाहीं । निर्गुण म्हणिजे गुणचि नाहीं । परब्रह्मासी ॥ १० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: परब्रह्मास प्राणीमात्रांचा संसर्कनाही. परब्रह्मामध्यें अवकाश किंवा मोकळी जागा नाहीं. तें सगळीकडे सारखें भरलेलें आहे. त्याला गुण नाहीत.
owis.englishMeaning: niranjan means there is no mind or world of knowledge. nirantar means there is no inner space (of `I am'). nirgun means there are no gunas in parabrahman.

owis.original: निःसंग म्हणिजे काये । निर्मळ म्हणिजे काये । निश्र्चळ म्हणिजे काये । मज निरोपावें ॥ ११ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: निःसंग, निर्मळ, निश्र्चळ म्हणजे काय तें मला सांगावें.
owis.englishMeaning: "nisanga means what? nirmala means what? nishchala means what? To me, there should be that discourse."

owis.original: निःसंग म्हणिजे संगचि नाहीं । निर्मळ म्हणिजे मळचि नाहीं । निश्र्चळ म्हणिजे चळण नाहीं । परब्रह्मासी ॥ १२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: परब्रह्मास आसक्ती नाहीम. कसलाही मल नाही. त्याला स्वस्थितीपासून चळण नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: nisanga means there is no attachment. nirmala means there is no dirt. nishchala/ still means there is no movement, to that parabrahman.

owis.original: निःशब्द म्हणिजे काये । निर्दोष म्हणिजे काये । निवृत्ती म्हणिजे काये । मज निरोपावरं ॥ १३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: निःशब्द, निर्दोष, निर्वृत्ति म्हणजे काय तें मला सांगावें.
owis.englishMeaning: "Without word means what? Without fault means what? nivritti means what? To me, there should be that discourse."

owis.original: निशब्द म्हणिजे शब्दचि नाहीं । निर्दोष म्हणिजे दोषची नाहीं । निःवृत्ती म्हणिजे वृत्तिच नाहीं । परब्रह्मासी ॥ १४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: परब्रह्माच्या ठिकाणीं शब्दाला किंवा भाषेला वाव नाहीं. कोणताही दोष नाही. कोणतीही वृत्ती नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: Without word means that not even this original word (`I am') is there. Without fault/ni- radosha means there is no body there (dosha- fault or constituent of body). nivritti means not even this knowing vritti is there in parabrahman.

owis.original: निःकाम म्हणिजे काये । निर्लेप म्हणिजे काये । निःकर्म म्हणिजे काये । मज निरोपावें ॥ १५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: निःकाम, निर्लेप, निहकर्म म्हणजे काय तें मला सांगावें.
owis.englishMeaning: "Without desire means what? Without touching means what? Without karma means what? To me, there should be that discourse."

owis.original: निःकाम म्हणिजे कामचि नाहीं । निर्लेप म्हणिजे लेपचि नाहीं । निःकर्म म्हणिजे कर्मचि नाहीं । परब्रह्मासी ॥ १६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: परब्रह्माला कोणतीही इच्छा नाहीं. त्याला कांहीं चिकटत नाहीं. त्याच्या ठिकाणीं कोणतेही कर्म नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: Without desire means there is no desire at all. Without touching means it does not take the touch. Without karma means there is no karma (ie. action, destiny), to that parabrahman.

owis.original: अनाम्य म्हणिजे काये । अजन्मा म्हणिजे काये । अप्रत्यक्ष म्हणिजे काये । मज निरोपावें ॥ १७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अनामा, आजन्मा, अप्रत्यक्ष म्हणजे काय तें मला सांगावें.
owis.englishMeaning: "Without name means what? Without birth means what? Without sensory perception means what? To me, there should be that discourse."

owis.original: आनाम्य म्हणिजे नामचि नाहीं । अजन्मा म्हणिजे जन्मचि नाहीं । अप्रत्यक्ष म्हणिजे प्रत्यक्ष नाहीं । परब्रह्म तें ॥ १८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: परब्रह्मास कांहीं नाव नाही. कारण त्यास रुप नाहीं. त्यास जन्म नाहीं. परब्रह्म इंद्रियांना गोचर नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: Without name means there is no name there. Without birth means, it is not born and without sensory perception means that parabrahman does not perceive through sensory organs.

owis.original: अगणीत म्हणिजे काये । अकर्तव्य म्हणिजे काये । अक्षै म्हणिजे काये । मज निरोपावें ॥ १९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अगणित, अकर्तव्य, अक्षय म्हणजे काय तें मला सांगावें.
owis.englishMeaning: "Uncountable means what? Without duty means what? Without destruction means what? To me, there should be that discourse."

owis.original: अगणीत म्हणिजे गणीत नाहीं । अकर्तव्य म्हणिजे कर्तव्यता नाहीं । अक्षै म्हणिजे क्षयचि नाहीं । परब्रह्मासी ॥ २० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: परब्रह्माचे मोजमाप करतां येत नाही. तें नीतिअनीतीच्या पलीकडे आहे. त्यास कधींच झीज नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: Uncountable means, that cannot be counted or measured. Without duty means, it has no duty (or, nothing needs to be done). Without destruction means that parabrahman cannot be destroyed.

owis.original: अरुप म्हणिजे काये । अलक्ष म्हणिजे काये । अनंत म्हणिजे काये । मज निरोपावें ॥ २१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अरुप, अलक्ष्य, अनंत म्हणजे काय तें मला सांगावें.
owis.englishMeaning: "Without form or shape means what? Imperceptible means what? ananta/ not ending means what? To me, there should be that discourse."

owis.original: अरुप म्हणिजे रुपचि नाहीं । अलक्ष म्हणिजे लक्षत नाहीं । अनंत म्हणिजे अंतचि नाहीं । परब्रह्मासी ॥ २२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: परब्रह्मास कोणतेंच रुप नाहीं. तें मनाला आकलन होत नाहीं. त्यास कधीं अंत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: Without form or shape means it has no form whatsoever. Imperceptible means there is no attention of any kind there. ananta means that parabrahman has no end.

owis.original: अपार म्हणिजे काये । अढळ म्हणिजे काये । अतर्क्ये म्हणिजे काये । मज निरोपावें ॥ २३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अपार, अधळ, अतर्क्य म्हणजे काय तें मला सांगावें.
owis.englishMeaning: "Limitless means what? Immovable means what? Without inference means what? To me, there should be that discourse."

owis.original: अपार म्हणिजे पारचि नाहीं । अधळ म्हणिजे ढळचि नाहीं । अतर्क्ये म्हणिजे तर्कत नाहीं । परब्रह्म तें ॥ २४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: परब्रह्म अमर्याद आहे. त्याचा परतीर गाठंता येत नाही. परब्रह्म आपल्या स्थानापासून कधींच ढळत नाहीं. भ्रष्ट होत नाहीं. बुद्धीला त्याच्या स्वरुपाबद्दल कल्पना करतां येत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: Limitless means it has no limit. Immovable means it does not move and without infe- rence means that parabrahman cannot be inferred or deduced.

owis.original: अद्वैत म्हणिजे काये । अदृश्य म्हणिजे काये । अच्युत म्हणिजे काये । मज निरोपावें ॥ २५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अद्वैत, अदृश्य, अच्युत म्हणजे काय तें मला सांगावें.
owis.englishMeaning: "Non-dual means what? Not visible means what? Not changing means what? To me, there should be that discourse."

owis.original: अद्वैत म्हणिजे द्वैतचि नाहीं । अदृश्य म्हणिजे दृश्यचि नाहीं । अच्युत म्हणिजे चेवत नाहीं । परब्रह्म तें ॥ २६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: परब्रह्म अगदी एकच एकआहे. तेथें दुसरें कांहीं नाहीं. परब्रह्म अतिंद्रिय आहे. इंद्रियांना कधीं गोचर होत नाहीं. तसेंच तें स्वस्थानापासून कधींही खाली घसरत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: Non-dual means there is no duality. Not visible means it cannot be seen. Not changing means it is fixed and steady, and that is parabrahman.

owis.original: अछेद म्हणिजे काये । अदाह्य म्हणिजे कये । अक्लेद म्हणिजे काये । मज निरोपावें ॥ २७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अच्छेद, अदाह्य, अक्लेद्य म्हणजे काय तें मला सांगावें.
owis.englishMeaning: "Non-breakable means what? Non-inflammable means what? Un-mixed means what? To me, there should be that discourse."

owis.original: अछेद म्हणिजे छेदेना । अदाह्य म्हणिजे जळेना । अक्लेद म्हणिजे कालवेना । परब्रह्म तें ॥ २८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: परब्रह्माला तोडता येत नाहीं. तें जळत नाहीं. तें भिजत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: Non-breakable means it cannot be divided or broken. Non-inflammable means it cannot be burnt. Un-mixed means that parabrahman has not mixed with anything else.

owis.original: परब्रह्म म्हणिजे सकळांपरतें । तपास पाहातां आपणचि तें । हें कळें अनुभवमतें । सद्गुरु केलियां ॥ २९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सांगण्याचें तात्पर्य असें कीं, परब्रह्म सार्‍या दृश्य विश्र्वाच्या पलीकडे आहे. त्याच्यासारखें तेंच आहे. दुसरें काहींहीं त्याच्यासारखें नाही. सद्गुरुची संगत केल्यानें अनुभव येतो. आणि मग परब्रह्माचें स्वरुप समजते.
owis.englishMeaning: parabrahman means beyond this `all' or `I am'. When you understand that Reality then, you become that Reality. That thoughtless Reality can be realized through the teaching of sadguru when first you understand this `I am' experience. .

source.name: Stotra (hymns) blog by Prakash Ketkar (ioustotra.blogspot.com) — original owi text and Marathi meaning

englishSource.name: Dasbodh, English translation by John Norwell (2015)

owis.original: जें जें कांहीं साकार दिसे । तें तें कल्पांती नासे । स्वरुप तें आसतचि असे । सर्वकाळ ॥ १ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जें जें आकारासहित असते तें तें अखेर नाश पावतें. पण परमात्स्वरुप मात्र सदासर्वकाळ जसेंच्या तसेंच राहतें.
owis.englishMeaning: When you see this `thing' with form (ie. `I am everywhere') then, that parabrahman, beyond all imagination, is not understood. Then that eternal swarup appears as a moment of time and there is this `I am' (this `I am' is the beginning of time ie. to simply be or in the `now').

owis.original: जें सकळांमध्यें सार । मिथ्या नव्हे तें साचार । जें कां नित्य निरंतर । संचलें असे ॥ २ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जें सर्व वस्तुंचें सार तत्व असतें तें पूर्णोणें सत्य असतें. तें कधींच खोटे होत नाही. तें सदैव सगळीकडें भरुन राहतें.
owis.englishMeaning: But even then that essence within this `I am' does not become false, for It is the only Truth. How can mula maya be that eternal and *nirantar that is complete and full? *(parabrahman-without an inner space or `I am')

owis.original: तें भगवंताचें निजरुप । त्यासि बोलिजे स्वरुप । याहि वेगळीं अमूप । नामें तयाचीं ॥ ३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तेंच भगवंताचें स्वतःचे रुप होय. त्याला स्वरुप असें म्हणतात. शिवाय त्यास आणखी पुष्कळ नांवें आहेत.
owis.englishMeaning: Only when this `I am' gets absorbed in that parabrahman can that be called the swarup. For this `I am' divides that immeasurable swarup.

owis.original: त्यास नामाचा संकेत । कळावया हा दृष्टांत । परी तें स्वरुप नामातीत । असतचि असे ॥ ४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: स्वरुपाला ओळखण्यासाठीं नाम हा एक संकेत आहे. त्याची कल्पना येण्यासाठीं दृष्टांत द्यावा लागतो. परंतु तें स्वरुप सर्व नामांच्या व दृष्टांतांच्या पलीकडे अगदीं जसेंच्या तसें असतें.
owis.englishMeaning: Though to understand that thoughtless swarup that is at the end of this visible `all', we first assign the qualities of this `I am' to that swarup. Still that swarup is ever-existing beyond this `I am'.

owis.original: दृश्यासबाह्य संचलें । परी तें विश्र्वास चोरलें । जवळिच नाहींसें जालें । असतचि कैसें ॥ ५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सर्व दृश्य पदार्थांच्या आंतबाहेर तें स्वरुप भरुन आहे. पण तें सर्वांपासून गुप्त आहे. प्रत्येकाच्या अगदी जवळ असूनसुद्धा तें त्यांना नसल्यासारखें झालेलें आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: It is completely full inside and outside of this visible `all', but is hidden to the world. How can That which only exists and is so close, seem like it is not?1

owis.original: ऐसा ऐकोनियां देव । उठे दृष्टीचा भाव । पाहों जातां दिसे सर्व । दृश्यचि आवघें ॥ ६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: भगवंताचे वर्णन ऐकून सामान्य माणसाला वाटते कीं भगवंताला डोळ्यांनी पहावें. पण तसें करावयास गेल्यावर सर्वत्र दृश्यच आढळते.
owis.englishMeaning: It is in fact God who is listening and this understanding of the `all' that arises, is Him. Still when you try to understand Him then, you will no longer see a world of many names and forms and you will perceive this visible `all'.

owis.original: दृष्टीचा विषयो दृश्य । तोचि जालियां सादृश्य । तेणें दृष्टी पावे संतोष । परी तें देखणें नव्हे ॥ ७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: दृश्य हा दृष्टीचा विषय होय. वस्तु दृश्य होऊन प्रत्यक्ष डोळ्यांनी पाहातां आली म्हणजे आम्ही वस्तु पाहीली असें वाटुन आनंद होतो. पण केवळ डोळ्यांनी पाहाणें हें कांहीं खरें पाहाणें नव्हे.
owis.englishMeaning: When this visible `all' is the object of your attention then, it is in truth, that atma appearing to Itself only. And due to this, your seeing gets satisfaction (ie. `I see myself everywhere'), but this vision of knowledge is not that Reality.

owis.original: दृष्टीस दिसे तें नासे । येतद्विषंई श्रुति असे । म्हणौन जें दृष्टीस दिसे । तें स्वरुप नव्हे ॥ ८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जें जें डोळ्यांनी दिसतें नाश पावतें. असें सांगणारें एक श्रुतिवचन आहे. (यद् दृष्टं तद् नष्टं ) म्हणून डोळ्यांना जें दिसतें तें स्वस्वरुप नव्हे.
owis.englishMeaning: When this visible is seen then, that Reality is lost. The shruti have spoken in regard to this (neti, neti/not this and not that). Therefore, whatever this mula maya sees it not that swarup.

owis.original: स्वरुप तें निराभास । आणी दृश्य भासलें साभास । भासास बोलिला नास । वेदांतशास्त्रीं ॥ ९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: स्वरुपाला भास नाहीं. दृष्याच्या ठिकाणीं भास आहे. मिथ्यापण आहे. भास नाशवंत असतो असें वेदान्तशास्त्र सांगतें.
owis.englishMeaning: That swarup is beyond any appearance and this `all' is the appearance of an apparent form. But the shasthras and vedanta have stated, this `speech' is an appearance and therefore destructible. (neti, not this world, and neti, not that `I am' either)

owis.original: आणी पाहातां दृश्यचि भासे । वस्तु दृश्यावेगळी असे । स्वानुभवें पाहातां दिसे । तें दृश्यासबाह्य ॥ १० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपण जेव्हां डोळ्यांनी पाहातों तेंव्हां फक्त दृश्य दिसतें. सद्ववस्तु किंवा स्वरुप सकल दृश्याहून वेगळी आहे. स्वरुपानुभव आला म्हणजे सद्वस्तु दृश्याला आंतबाहेर व्यापून आहे असें दिसतें.
owis.englishMeaning: And if it is understood that this visible `all' is also an appearance and not true then, there is that Self separate from this visible. This is Self-experience/swa-anubhav and it is understood that whatever is seen, inside and outside of this `all', is that Reality. 1Gospel of Thomas- Jesus said, "If the flesh came into being because of spirit, that is a marvel, but if spirit came into being because of the body, that is a marvel of marvels. Yet I marvel at how this great wealth has come to dwell in this poverty."

owis.original: जें निराभास निर्गुण । त्याची काये सांगावी खूण । परी तें स्वरुप जाण । सन्निधचि असे ॥ ११ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: स्वरुपाला आभास किंवा गुण नाही. त्यामुळें त्याला ओळखण्याची खूण सांगता येत नाही. तरी ही तें स्वरुप जवळच आहे. यांत शंका नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: Then this mula maya is that nirgun, void of any appearance. What can be told about That? (words come back from that inexpressible Self). But when that swarup is knowing then that Self is very close by (ie. when there is witnessing, then He is felt to be near by).

owis.original: जैसा आकाशीं भासला भास । आणी सकळांमधें आकाश । तैसा जाणिजे जगदीश सबाह्य अभ्यंतरीं ॥ १२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपण आकाश पाहतों. त्यावेळीं आपल्याला आकाश दिसलें असा भास होतो. आकाश वेगळेंपणानें आपल्याला दिसत नाही. कारण सर्व बाजूंना तें पसरलेलें आहे. त्याचप्रमाणें परमेश्र्वर सर्व दृश्य वस्तूंना सगळीकडे आंत व बाहेर व्यापून आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: Just as in the space this `all' appears (when nothing is there, everything is there) and in this `all' there is this space. So too, one should know that the `Lord of the world' is inside and outside of this world (ie. He is this space from which the world appears and He is beyond this space even).

owis.original: उदकामधें परी भिजेना । पृथ्वीमधें परी झिजेना । वन्हीमधें परी सिजेना । स्वरुप देवाचें ॥ १३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: भगवंताचें स्वरुप पाण्यांत व्यापून आहे पण तें भिजत नाहीं. पृथ्वीमध्यें व्यापून आहे पण झिजत नाहीं. अग्नीमध्यें तें व्यापून आहे पण जळत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: He is in the water but is not wet. He is in the earth but does not get worn away. He is in the fire, but that swarup of God does not get burnt.

owis.original: तें रेंद्यामधें परी बुडेना । तें वायोमधें परी उडेना । सुवर्णीं असे परी घडेना । सुवर्णासारिखें ॥ १४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तें चिखलामध्यें व्यापून आहे पण बुडत नाही. वार्‍यामध्यें व्यापून आहे पण उडत नाही. सोन्यामध्यें व्यापून आहे पण त्याचे सोन्यासारखें दागिने बनवता येत नाहीत.
owis.englishMeaning: That is in the mire but does not drown. That is in the wind but does not fly away. That is in the gold but it does not get formed into golden ornaments.

owis.original: ऐसें जें संचलें सर्वदा । परी ते आकळेना कदा । अभेदामाजीं वाढवी भेदा । ते हे अहंता ॥ १५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अशा रीतीनें सदासर्वकाळ सर्व ठिकाणीं घनदाटपणें भरुन राहिलेलें स्वस्वरुप अनुभवाच्या कक्षेंत आणणें कठीण असतें. त्या भेदरहित स्वरुपामध्यें अहंता भेद निर्माण करते.
owis.englishMeaning: That pervades like mula maya but that swarup can never be understood. And if a division appears in that indivisible thoughtless swarup then, there is this ahamta/ego of `I am' (ie. space).

owis.original: तिच्या स्वरुपाची खूण । सांगों कांहीं वोळखण । अहंतेचे निरुपण । सावध ऐका ॥ १६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अहंतेचें स्वरुप ध्यानांत यावें म्हणून कांहीं खुणा सांगतो. अहंतेचें हे विवेचन लक्ष देऊन ऐकावें.
owis.englishMeaning: If the understanding of that swarup becomes this known `thing' then, you should listen very alertly to this ahamta/`I am'. For the only way to become that swarup is to remain as this `thing'.

owis.original: जे स्वरुपाकडे पावे । अनुभवासवें झेपावे । अनुभवाचे शब्द आघवे । बोलोन दावी ॥ १७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अहंता सूक्ष्म होत जाऊन स्वरुपापर्यंत पोहोचते. ती स्वरुपाच्या अनुभवाच्या मागें मागें राहाते. अनुभव जेथपर्यंत जाईल तेथपर्यंत जाते. मग तो अनुभव शब्दांनीं वर्णन करुन सांगते.
owis.englishMeaning: When mula maya reaches towards that swarup then, this ahamta/ego springs up along with this `experience' and then, while `speaking' this `word', it takes the ego of a gross body and shows the `many' things.

owis.original: म्हणे आतां मीच स्वरुप । तेंचि अहंतेचें रुप । निराकारीं आपोआप । वेगळी पडे ॥ १८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: " मीच स्वस्वरुप आहें " हें अहंतेचे रुप समजावें. निराकार व भेदरहित स्वस्वरुपामध्यें ती आपोआप वेगळेपणानें नजरेस पडते.
owis.englishMeaning: If It says `Now, I am that swarup' then, that Reality has become a form with its ego and this `I am' within that formless swarup separates itself from the swarup and sets out on its own.

owis.original: स्वयें मीच आहे ब्रह्म । ऐसा अहंतेचा भ्रम । ऐसिये सूक्ष्मीं सूक्ष्म । पाहातां दिसे ॥ १९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ' स्वतः मीच ब्रह्म आहे हा अहंतेचा भ्रम आहे. अत्यंत सूक्ष्मांत जाऊन सूक्ष्मपणें पाहिलें म्हणजे माझें हें बोलणें बरोबर कळेल.
owis.englishMeaning: `I am myself brahman'. Such is the delusion of this ahamta/ego. Such understanding is that brahman appearing within that brahman.

owis.original: कल्पना आकळी हेत । वस्तु कल्नातीत । म्हणौन नाकळे अंत । अनंताचा ॥ २० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: " मी देह आहे " ही जशी कल्पना तशीच " मी ब्रह्म आहे " हीं देखिल कल्पनाच आहे. कल्पनेंतून भावना निर्माण होते. सद्वस्तु किंवा स्वस्वरुप तर कल्पनेच्या पलीकडे आहे. कल्पना स्वरुपाला मर्यादा घालूं पाहातें. पण तें अनंत असल्यानें त्याला मर्यादा घालतां येत नाही. स्वरुपाचा अंत लागत नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: Imagination confines and then there is this original intent (ie. `I want to be'). But that Self is beyond imagination. Therefore, the end of that endless Self cannot be understood (due to imagination, one feels that this knowledge is endless; maharaj- put an end to that endless).

owis.original: अन्वये आणी वीतरेक । हा शब्दभेद कोणीयेक । निशब्दाचा आंतरविवेक । शोधिला पाहिजे ॥ २१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अन्वय व व्यतिरेक हा एक शब्दांचा भेद आहे. सद्ववस्तु खरोखर निःशब्द आहे. म्हणून आपल्या अंतर्यामीं खोल शिरुन निःशब्द स्वस्वरुपाचा शोध घ्यावा.
owis.englishMeaning: Through the two systems of logic, anvaya and vyatirek, this `I am' can be proved 2 and then, with this vivek of `I am' that `wordless' swarup should be searched for. (When there is the knowledge of the waking state then, there is the waking state and when 2Sadachar Through the methods of anvaya (When there is a cause then only is there an effect) and vyatireka (When there is no cause then there is no affect), knowledge can be determined. there is no waking state, still knowledge is there. And when there is the knowledge of the dream state then, there is the dream and no waking state but still knowledge is there. And you know that you slept so, knowledge must have been there also within deep sleep. Knowledge is the commom cause of the resultant three states and without knowledge, these three states cannot be)

owis.original: आधीं घेईजे वाच्यांश । मग वोळखिजे लक्ष्यांश । लक्ष्यांशीं पाहातां वाच्यांश । असेल कैंचा ॥ २२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: स्वस्वरुपाचें वर्णन शब्दांनी केलेले असते. त्या शब्दांचा अर्थ प्रथम नीट समजून घ्यावा. शब्दांचा अर्थ बरोबर समजणें हा वाच्यार्थ होय. पण शब्द खुणेंने सद्वस्तुचें वर्णन करतात. म्हणून वाच्यार्थ ध्यानांत आल्यावर सद्वस्तुची बरोबर कल्पना करावी. हा लक्ष्यांश होय. एकदा लक्ष्यांश ध्यानांत आला म्हणजे वाचार्थाला महत्व उरत नाहीं. एकच लक्ष्यांश निरनिराळ्या शब्दांनीं सांगतां येणें शक्य असतें. या कारणानें शब्दांना लक्ष्यांशापेक्षां कमी महत्व असते.
owis.englishMeaning: This `word' meaning at the beginning should be searched out and then the implied meaning should be recognized (ie. first there is the `word' meaning of `You are That'/tat- twasmi. Therefore the `word' meaning of you should be understood. You discover that you cannot be this "I" that has attached itself to the body and that you are always there as knowledge. And that you are the base of the three worlds. Without you, they could not exist. Then there is the implied meaning of `you'. When this is investigated then, you discover that you are that purush, the witness or Knower of this known or `all'). And when there is the understanding of the implied meaning then, how can there be this `word' meaning? (Now when the `word' meaning of That is enquired into, one discovers it means that witnessing purush. Thus the implied meaning of `you' and the `word' meaning of That, are the same. But the implied meaning of That is that, the witnessing purush is, in truth, that One brahman without another. Thus you are that brahman)

owis.original: सर्वब्रह्म आणी विमळब्रह्म । हा वाच्यांशाचा अनुक्रम । शोधितां लक्ष्यांशाचें वर्म । वाच्यांश नसे ॥ २३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सर्वब्रह्मवादी म्हणतो कीं, " सर्व दृश्य बाजूस केल्यावर जें शुद्ध व निर्मल ब्रह्मस्वरुप उरतें तें ब्रह्म होय. ब्रह्मवर्णानाचे हे दोन प्रकार केवळ शब्दापुरतें भिन्न आहेत. दोन्हींचा लक्ष्यांश जें परब्रह्म तें अगदी एकच एक आहे. तेथें भेद उरत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: The `word' meaning is this `all' is brahman and the implied meaning is that pure brahman. These two understandings are to be studied in sequence. First the `word' meaning of that thoughtless swarup is to be understood and then, when the implied meaning (ie. that thoughtless pure brahman) is understood, the `word'/`all' will be destroyed.

owis.original: सर्व विमळ दोनी पक्ष । वाच्यांशीं आटती प्रत्यक्ष । लक्ष्यांशीं लावितां लक्ष । पक्षपात घडे ॥ २४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सर्वब्रह्म व विमलब्रह्म हे दोन्ही पक्ष वाच्यांशामध्यें आटून जातात. शब्दांच्या पलीकडे त्यांचे क्षेत्र नाहीं. शब्दांच्या कक्षेंतच तें वावरतात. स्वस्वरुप हें दोन्हींचा लक्ष्यांश आहे. तिकडे लक्ष लागलें कीं दोन्हीं पक्ष गळून पडतात. त्यांचा नाश होतो.
owis.englishMeaning: This `all' and that pure brahman are the two sides of prakruti and purush (ie. this `all' is prakruti and the purush is that pure brahman). In this `word' meaning, sensory perception (ie. body consciousness) dries up and when this `I am' attention is planted within the implied meaning (I do not exist) then, this `I am' also disappears and the 3Note: in the Bible, John 1.1-5 it says, In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God and the Word was God. He was in the beginning with God. All things were made through Him and without Him nothing was made, that was made. In Him was life and the life was the light of men. And the light shines in the darkness and the darkness does not recognize it. pure brahman remains.

owis.original: हें लक्ष्यांशें अनुभवणें । येथें नाहीं वाच्यांश बोलणें । मुख्य अनुभवाचे खुणे । वाचारंभ कैचा ॥ २५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: लक्ष्यांशावर लक्ष केंद्रित करुनच स्वस्वरुपाचा अनुभव घ्यावा. त्या अनुभवामध्यें शब्द बोलण्याचे काम नाही. कारण अनुभव शब्दांच्या पलीकडे असतो. निःशब्द अवस्थेंत जाणें ही स्वरुपानुभवाची मुख्य खुण आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: When that thoughtless implied meaning has been gained on account of this `I am' experience then, this `word' meaning cannot to be `spoken'. When that Supreme under- standing is gained through this `experience' then, how can there be this original speech of para (`I am')?

owis.original: परा पश्यंती मधेमां वैखरी । जेथें वोसरती च्यारी । तेथें शब्दकळाकुंसरी । कोण काज ॥ २६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: परा, पश्यन्ति, मध्यमा व वैखरी या चारही वाणी स्वरुपानुभवाच्या ठिकाणीं ओस पडतात, शून्य होतात. म्हणून तेथें शब्दचातुर्याचें काम उरतनाहीं. तेथें शब्दांची कला लटकी पडते.
owis.englishMeaning: When there are the *para, pashyanti, madhyama and vaikari (ie. the articulated word) then, there is body consciousness and that One brahman fades away within these four speeches. But `there' in that brahman, who will have the skills of the articulated words or the `art' of this `word'? *(The world gets created by these four speeches; from the para of `I am', a thought starts to form; then it gets formed and one feels, "I must say this" and finally the thought is spoken out. This process of this original `word' becoming `many' words is the power of maya)

owis.original: शब्द बोलतां सवेंच नासे । तेथें शाश्वतता कोठें असे । प्रत्यक्षास प्रमाण नसे । बरें पाहा ॥ २७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपण शब्द उच्चारला कीं तो लगेच नाश पावतो. म्हणून शब्द अशाश्वत असतो. तें अशाश्वतपण आपण प्रत्यक्ष पाहतों. त्यास आणखी पुरावा लागतच नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: This `word' that is silently uttered will, of its own *accord, disappear. How can this therefore be that eternal brahman `there'? That brahman cannot be understood when you see this world through the sensory organs. But He can be understood by means of this pure sattwa. *(When you awake it arises and when you sleep is disappears. Of this process you have no control. But through vivek this `word' can be understood and by further vivek this `word' too, will fade away)

owis.original: शब्द प्रत्यक्ष नासिवंत । म्हणोन घडे पक्षपात । सर्व विमळ ऐसा हेत । अनुभवीं नाहीं ॥ २८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: शब्द नाशवंत आहे. म्हणून तत्त्वज्ञानामधील वाद अखेर गळून पडतात. सर्वब्रह्मवाद व विमलब्रह्मवाद असे पक्ष स्वरुपानुभवामध्यें शिल्लक उरत नाहीत.
owis.englishMeaning: This `word' and sensory perception are both destructible and therefore you have to have faith in that pure brahman. This `all' is the original inspiration and it is not that pure brahman that is within this `experience'.

owis.original: ऐक अनुभवाचें लक्षण । अनुभव म्हणिजे अनन्य जाण । ऐक अनन्याचें लक्षण । ऐसें असे ॥ २९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अनुभवाचें लक्षण ऐकावें. अनुभव म्हणजे स्वरुपाशी अनन्यपण होय. आतां अनन्यपणाचें लक्षण सांगतों.
owis.englishMeaning: If you listen then, there is this `experience'.4 `Experience' means that *`no-otherness' is knowing (ie. and otherness has come). When you listen then, that attention of `no- otherness' becomes like this `experience' (The attention of `no-otherness' is the attention of the sadhu or Master. He uses this knowledge but never becomes this knowledge ie. implied meaning. The listening of the sadhak is not like that. His attention brings this `experience' and destroys body consciousness ie. `word' meaning). *(When this knowledge of `I am'/`another' merges in that Reality)

owis.original: अनन्य म्हणिजे अन्य नसे । आत्मनिवेदन जैसें । संगभंगें असतचि असे । आत्मा आत्मपणें ॥ ३० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अन्य नाहीं तें अनन्य. जसें कीं, आत्मनिवेदन. अहंतेनें अन्यपण किंवा निराळेंपण येतें. पण अहंता गेली कीं आत्मा एकच एक आत्मपणानें जसाच्या तसा असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: No-otherness means there is no other and such is the surrender to the atma. It means That which is, when every attachment has been destroyed. It is the atma, by being the atma.

owis.original: आत्म्यास नाहीं आत्मपण । हेंचि निःसंगाचें लक्षण । हें वाक्यांशें बोलिलें जाण । कळवया कारणें ॥ ३१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: " मी आत्मा आहे " अशी आत्मपणाची जाणीव आत्मस्वरुपास नसते. असें केवलस्वरुपानें असणें हेंच अत्यंत संगरहित असण्याची खूण आहे. हे शब्दांच्या पलीकडे आहे. पण कल्पनायेण्यासा्ठीं शब्दांनी वर्णन केलें.
owis.englishMeaning: To that atma, there is no sense of being the atma. That thoughtless atma uses this knowledge but has no attachment to this knowledge. That thoughtless atma knows due to this `word' and that thoughtless atma is also understood by means of this `speech'/`word' (ie. when this `I am' gets absorbed into that swarup then it is not dif- ferent from that swarup and this is `no-otherness'. And this `I am' is also the medium by which He creates and knows His creation).

owis.original: येरवी लक्ष्यांश तो वाच्यांशें । सांगिजेल हें घडे कैसें । वाक्यविवरणें अपैसें । कळों लागे ॥ ३२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सद्वस्तुचे स्वरुप शब्दांनीं सांगतां येण्यासारखें नाही. परमतु संतवचनांवर चिंतन व मनन केलें तरच तें आकलन होऊं लागतें.
owis.englishMeaning: Otherwise, tell me, how will that thoughtless implied meaning ever be understood without first knowing this `word' meaning? By deep investigation of this `I am', That which is *beyond this space is understood. *(parabrahman)

owis.original: करावें तत्वविवरण । शोधावें ब्रह्म निर्गुण । पाहावें आपणास आपण । म्हणिजे कळे ॥ ३३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: या दृश्य विश्र्वांतील तत्त्वांचें विवरण करावें, निर्गुण ब्रह्माचा शोध घ्यावा, आपण कोण तें नीट पाहावें, म्हणजे स्वरुप कसें आहें तें कळूं लागतें.
owis.englishMeaning: This great element (ie. space/zero/sagun) should be investigated and with this you should search out that nirgun brahman. You should understand your Self and that is the nirgun understanding.

owis.original: हें न बोलतांच विवरिजे । विवरोन विरोन राहिजे । मग अबोलणेंचि साजे । माहापुरुषीं ॥ ३४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: स्वरुपाविषयीं बोलणें थांबवून त्याचें अखंड मनन करावें. तसें करतां करतां त्यामध्यें लीन होऊन जावें. अशा रीतीनें स्वस्वरुपाशीं अनन्य झाल्यावर माणूस महापुरुष बनतो. त्याला मौन शोभून दिसतें.
owis.englishMeaning: That thoughtless Self that cannot be `spoken' of should be carefully investigated. But first investigate this `speech' and then, this `speech' will dissolve and thoughtlessness will remain and you will come upon that `unspoken' and great purush.

owis.original: शब्दचि निशब्द होती । श्रुति नेति नेति म्हणती । हें तों आलें आत्मप्रचिती । प्रत्यक्ष आतां ॥ ३५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: स्वरुपानुभवामध्यें शब्द शब्दपणानें विरुन जातात. ही अवस्था श्रुति असें नाहीं असें नाहीं म्हणून म्हणते. ती असें कां म्हणते याचा प्रत्यय आतां स्वतःला येतो.
owis.englishMeaning: Then this `word' has become that `wordless' swarup. The shruti could only say, neti, neti/not this and not that, but then, within that atma `experience' there came the sensory perception of `many' objects.

owis.original: प्रचित आलियां अनुमान । हा तों प्रत्यक्ष दुराभिमान । तरी आतां मी अज्ञान । मज कांहींच न कळे ॥ ३६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अशा प्रकारचा स्वरुपानुभव आल्यावर तर्काच्या व अनुमानाच्या मागें लागणें हें मीपणाचें लक्षण आहे. पण हा मी कसा आहे तो पहा. अनुमानाचा हट्ट धरणारा मी अज्ञाानी आहे. त्याला कांहींच कळत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: When this `experience' brings conjecture then, that thoughtless Self is the experiences we get through our senses and that paramatma has the ego of a body and far away from its Self. Then there comes the understanding, "I am ignorant and I have not understood this `thing'."

owis.original: मी लटिका माझें बोलणें लटिकें । मी लटिका माझें चालणें लटिकें । मी माझें अवघेंचि लटिकें । काल्पनिक ॥ ३७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: हा मी मुळांतच खोटा असल्यानें त्याचें बोलणें चालणें खोटेच आहे. त्याचें माझेपण सर्व खोटे आहे. काल्पनिक आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: But even this `I' is false and my `speech' is false; `I' is false and my `action' is false. `I' and `mine' are both false and imagined by the mind only. Understand in this way.

owis.original: मज मुळींच नाहीं ठाव । माझें बोलणें अवघेंचि वाव । हा प्रकृतीचा स्वभाव । प्रकृती लटिकी ॥ ३८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: त्याला मुळीं स्थानच नाहीं. त्याचें सारें बोलणें अर्थहीन असतें. हा मी व त्याचे सारे व्यवहार प्रकृतीजन्य आहेत. आणि प्रकृति तर खोटी आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: `My' has no place at the root. Due to the worthless mind, my `speech' (`I am') has come about (ie. whatever comes out of the worthless will also be worthless). Then that thoughtless swarup is the nature of the prakruti; and this prakruti is false.

owis.original: प्रकृति आणी पुरुष । यां दोहींस जेथें निरास । तेथें मीपण विशेष । हें केवि घडे ॥ ३९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: स्वरुपानुभवामध्यें प्रकृति व पुरुष या दोघांचा निरास होतो. दोघांचा स्वरुपांत लय होतो. मग त्या ठिकाणीं प्रकृतींतून प्रगट होणार्‍या मीला वेगळेपनें अस्तित्व उरणें अगदीच अशक्य आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: When there is prakruti then, there is that purush. But when this `speech'/prakruti dissolves in that purush then, how can `I'-ness appear, for there is only thoughtlessness `there'?

owis.original: जेथें सर्व हि अशेष जालें । तेथें विशेष कैंचे आलें । मी मौनी म्हणतां भंगलें । मौन्य जैसें ॥ ४० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ज्या ठिकाणीं सर्व दृश्य निःशेष नाहींसें होतें त्या ठिकाणीं विशेषपणानें मी कसा उरणार ? मौन पाळणारा एक माणूस म्हणाल " मी मौनव्रत धरलें आहे. " त्याच्या या बोलण्यानेंच त्याचे मौन भंग पावतें.
owis.englishMeaning: If this `all' `here' does not remain then, how can this pure sattwa be `there'? (This `all' is pure sattwa, the beginning of maya) It would be like breaking that silence/mouna to say, "I am in silence/mouna."

owis.original: आतां मौन्य न भंगावें । करुन कांहींच न करावें । असोन निशेष नसावें । विवेकबळें ॥ ४१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: म्हणून स्वानुभव घ्यावा, त्यांत राहून मौन भंगूं देऊं नये. सर्व कांहीं करुन कांहीं केलें नाहीं असें निःसंग असावें. आणि दिसायल वेगळें दिसून अनुभवानें अगदी मुळींच निराळें नसावें.
owis.englishMeaning: Now, that silence should not be broken and then, even while *doing, this `thing' does not do (ie. for there is `no-otherness'). Therefore by constant vivek, you should be, by utterly not being at all. *(With this `thing' the Master stays in the world but doesn't take the touch) .

source.name: Stotra (hymns) blog by Prakash Ketkar (ioustotra.blogspot.com) — original owi text and Marathi meaning

englishSource.name: Dasbodh, English translation by John Norwell (2015)

owis.original: श्रोतीं केला अनुमान । ऐसें कैसें ब्रह्मज्ञाान । कांहींच नाहीं असोन । हें केवि घडे ॥ १ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मागील समासाच्या शेवटीं  " करुन कांहींच न करावें, असून कांहींच नसावें " असें वक्त्यानें सांगितलें. त्यावर श्रोत्यानें शंका काढली कीं,  " ब्रह्मज्ञान असें कसें असतें ? " आपण असून नसावें. हें कसें शक्य आहे ? "
owis.englishMeaning: If in the listener, conjecture has been created then, how then can there be that knowledge of brahman? If this `thing' is not then, how can thoughtlessness ever be achieved?

owis.original: सकळ करुन अकर्ता । सकळ भोगून अभोक्ता । सकळांमध्यें अलिप्तता । येईल कैसी ॥ २ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सगळीं कर्में करुन अकर्तेपणा, सगळे भोग भोगून अभोक्तेपणा, आणि सगळ्यांत राहून अलिप्तपणा येईल कसा ?
owis.englishMeaning: The listener says (ie. conjecture is created), "If there is this `all' doing and that non- doer (ie. purush) and if there is this `all' enjoying and that non-enjoyer then, how can that untouched purush within this `all' be realised?" (ie. when there is prakruti/purush then, this is the beginning of maya; the `all' ie. prakruti is doing and the non-doer is the hidden purush within. This is the witness state and there you identify with this prakruti but not that purush)

owis.original: तथापी तुम्ही म्हणतां । योगी भोगून अभोक्ता । स्वर्गनर्कहि आतां । येणेंचि न्यायें ॥ ३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तथापि आपण म्हणतां कीं, योगी भोग भोग ून अभोक्ता राहतो. तर मग स्वर्ग व नरक यांच्या भोगांना हा अभोक्तेपणाचा नियम लागूं करावयास पाहिजे.
owis.englishMeaning: "Still you say the yogi enjoys and is the non-enjoyer. How can heaven and hell and this `I am' be enjoyed and yet not enjoyed?" (ie. this world is our heaven and our hell; its to this world we return to when we leave this body. And here we say, "We are enjoying" or "We are suffering." Even if we cast off this world still there is an enjoyer of knowledge. But the Master tells us that even this is not true and He sees only Himself)

owis.original: जन्म मृत्य भोगिलेच भोगी । परी तो भोगून अभोक्ता योगी । यातना हि तयालागी । येणेंचि पाडें ॥ ४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जन्म व मृत्यु यांचे भोग भोगावेंच लागतात. पण तें भोग भोगून योगी अभोक्ता राहतो. असें जर आहे तर भोगाच्या यातना भोगून देखील योगी त्या भोगीत नाहीं. असें म्हणावें लागेल.
owis.englishMeaning: "Everyone endures the suffering of birth and death, but you say that, the yogi suf- fers and yet still He does not suffer. That these sufferings He has cast off, due to His thoughtless understanding."

owis.original: कुटून नाहीं कुटिला । रडोनि नाहीं रडला । कुंथोन नाहीं कुंथिला । योगेश्र्वर ॥ ५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: याचा अर्थ असा होतो कीं, योगी पुरुष मार खाऊन मार खात नाहीं, शोकानें रडतो पण रडत नाहीं, शरीर दुःख सहन न होऊन कण्हतो पण तो कण्हत नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: "Then though He is thrashed still, He is not thrashed and though He is crying still He is not crying. And though He makes great efforts still, He is making no effort whatsoever, for He is the Lord of yoga."

owis.original: जन्म नसोन घातला । पतित नसोन जाला । यातना नसोन पावला । नानापरी ॥ ६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: त्याला जन्म नसून जन्म घेतो. पतित नसून पतित होतो. आणि यातना नसून नाना प्रकारच्या यातना त्याला भोगाव्या लागतात.
owis.englishMeaning: "You say that He is born and yet not born; that He has come down into a body and yet not come down; that He suffers in `many' ways and yet does not suffer?"

owis.original: ऐसा श्रोतयांचा अनुमान । श्रोतीं घेतलें आडरान । आतां याचें समाधान । केलें पाहिजे ॥ ७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: वक्त्याच्या बोलण्यावर तर्क चालवून श्रोत्यानें काढलेलें हें अनुमान बरोबर नाहीं. श्रोता विचारांच्या आडरानांत पडला आहे. तरी आतां त्याचे समाधान केलें पाहिजे.
owis.englishMeaning: Such were the conjectures of the listener, for in the listener these wanderings of the mind have been *accepted. Therefore now this `speech' should be created and that samadhan should be realized. *(maharaj you welcome the thoughts)

owis.original: वक्ता म्हणे सावध व्हावें । तुम्ही बोलतां बरवें । परी हें तुमच्याच अनुभवें । तुम्हास घडे ॥ ८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: वक्ता म्हणतो कीं, श्रोत्यांनीं नीट श्रवण करावें. तुमचें म्हणणें तुम्हांस येणार्‍या अनुभवाच्या दृष्टीनें बरोबर आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: The speaker says, be alert and listen. When you leave your worries and concepts that you have created then, you `speak' very well (ie. this `I am' naturally remains), but your `experience' has not met with that thoughtless swarup. (You are the only One; you do not even have knowledge. But this `speech' or `I am' has created separateness and after- wards you fell down into body consciousness. And as long as your thoughtless swarup is not understood and this `I am' is not merged in That then, this indecisive under- standing will waver between this `I am' experience and body consciousness. Therefore firm understanding and conviction are required).

owis.original: ज्याचा अनुभव जैसा । तो तो बोलतो तैसा । संपदेविण जो धिवसा । तो निरार्थक ॥ ९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ज्याला जसा अनुभव येतो तसा तो जीवनाचा अर्थ समजतो. आणि सांगतो. ज्याच्याजवळ फार संपत्ती नसते तो मोठें साहस करुं शकत नाही. तसा प्रयनही निरर्थक असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: As is our experience, so will be our talk. If that purush has this `experience' then, He will utter `I am'. But if that purush has no courage then, he will say these things which are empty and vain (then this inner `speech' becomes the `many' empty and vain words and He will be full of doubts). (maharaj have the courage to be He)

owis.original: नाहीं ज्ञानची संपदा । अज्ञानदारिद्रें आपदा । भोगिल्याच भोगी सदा । शब्दज्ञानें ॥ १० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ज्या माणसाजवळ आत्मज्ञारुपी संपत्ती नसते, त्याच्याजवळ अज्ञानरुपी दारिद्र्य असतें. त्यामुळे तो अनेक दुःखे भोगतो. त्याची गति फक्त शब्दज्ञानापर्यंतच असते.
owis.englishMeaning: Where there is not the fullness of knowledge then, there is the misfortune and poverty of ignorance and He is confined within a mind. But when there is this knowledge of the `word' then, that eternal Self will be the enjoyer enjoying.

owis.original: योगी वोळखावा योगेश्र्वरें । ज्ञानी वोळखावा ज्ञानेश्र्वरें । माहाचतुर तो चतुरें । वोळखावा ॥ ११ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: योग्याची अवस्था योग्यासच कळते. ज्ञान्याची अवस्था ज्ञानी पुरुषासच कळते. चतुर पुरुषच मोठ्या चतुर पुरुषास ओळखूं शकतो.
owis.englishMeaning: The yogi should be recognized by that Lord of yoga. The gnyani should be recognized by the Lord of knowledge and the wise should recognize that `most wise' (ie. the atma). (ie. you will only recognize the body when you stay as a body and you can only recognize God when you are God).

owis.original: अनुभवी अनुभवियास कळे । अलिप्त अलिप्तपणें निवळें । विदेहाचा देहभाव गळे । विदेही देखतां ॥ १२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: स्वानुभवी पुरुषच आत्मज्ञानी पुरुषास ओळखतो. जो स्वतः अलिप्त असतो तोच अलिप्तपणानें संपन्न पुरुष ओळखतो. स्वतः विदेही असलेला पुरुष दुसर्‍या विदेही पुरुषास पाहून देहभान विसरतो.
owis.englishMeaning: The one with this `experience' understands this `experience' only and the one who does not touch this `experience' is purified by remaining untouched and this body awareness that is within the *videha is dropped in the presence of the videha. *(The One without body will be recognized when you leave the body through vivek)

owis.original: बद्धासारिखा सिद्ध । आणी सिद्धासारिखा बद्ध । येक भावील तो अबद्ध । म्हणावाच नलगे ॥ १३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: नुसत्या देहावरुन बघितलें तर एखादा सिद्ध पुरुष बद्धा सारखा दिसतो व बद्ध पुरुष सिद्धासारखा म्हणुन दोघांची योग्यता एकच आहे असें जो मानतो तो मूर्ख आहे हें सांगावयास नको.
owis.englishMeaning: "The siddha is the same as the baddha/bonded and the bonded is the same as a siddha." If one thinks like this then, it goes without saying that, that atma has become wild and foolish. (It is true; the baddha is the siddha but, he doesn't know Himself)

owis.original: झडपला तो देहधारी । आणी देहधारक पंचाक्षरी । परंतु दोघां येकसरी । कैसी द्यावी ॥ १४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: भूतबाधा झालेला माणूस व भूत काढून टाकणारा पंचाक्षरी माणूस दोघे देहानें सारखेंच दिसतात. पण दोघांची योग्यता सारखीं नसते.
owis.englishMeaning: The one possessed by a spirit (ie. body ego) is the holder of a body and the one who exorcises this spirit, is also a holder of a body (ie. the `all' is his body), but how can both be taken to be the same?

owis.original: तैसा अज्ञान पतित । आणी ज्ञानी जीवनमुक्त । दोघे समान मानील तो युक्त । कैसा म्हणावा ॥ १५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: त्याचप्रमाणे एखदा भ्रष्ट अज्ञानी माणूस व एखादा जीवनमुक्त ज्ञानी पुरुष दोघेही देहानें सारखेंच दिसतात. म्हणून दोघांची योग्यता सारखीच म्हणणारा माणूस विचारी कसा म्हणावा ?
owis.englishMeaning: In the same way, if the fallen and ignorant jiva regards himself as a jivanmukti or gnyani then, how could he be called shrewd?

owis.original: आतां असो हे दृष्टांत । प्रचित बोलों कांहीं हेत । येथें श्रोतीं सावचित्त । क्षणयेक व्हावें ॥ १६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आतां हें दृष्टांत पुरें. स्वरुपानुभवाच्या कांहीं खुणा आतां सांगतो. श्रोत्यांनीं क्षणभर लक्ष देऊन त्या ऐकाव्यात.
owis.englishMeaning: It is the thoughtless Self, beyond this visible `all', that has become this `now' (ie. by forgetting everything). Then He is this `experience', this `speech', this `thing'and this original intent (ie. `I want to be, I want to know'). Therefore when `here' within the listener, there should be the alertness of this `now' then, He can be revealed.

owis.original: जो जो ज्ञानें गुप्त जाला । जो विवेकें विराला । जो अनन्यपणें उरला । नाहींच कांहीं ॥ १७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आत्मज्ञानाच्या योगानें जो गुप्त होतो, म्हणजे ज्याचा मीपणा अंतर्धान पावतो, निदिध्यासानें जो स्वरुपामध्यें विलीन होतो, आणि स्वरुपाशी एकरुप झाल्यानें जो यत्किंचित वेगळेपणानें उरत नाहीं,
owis.englishMeaning: That hidden purush is perceived due to knowledge. That purush is made *so open by His vivek. And then that purush remains by no-otherness, without being this `thing' even. *(maharaj- He is so open He doesn't take the touch of anything)

owis.original: तयास कैसें गवसावें । शोधूं जातां तोचि व्हावें । तोचि होतां म्हणावें । नलगे कांहीं ॥ १८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: त्याला सापडवणें सोपें नसतें. जो त्याला शोधावयास जातो, तो स्वतः तेंच रुप बनतो. तो स्वतः तेंच झाल्यावर सगळें खुंटतें. बाकी कांहीं उरतच नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: "But how to find that Reality?" If you should search for Him then, He only will be and when He only is then, it will not be necessary to call Him this `thing' (ie. the beginning of otherness).

owis.original: देहीं पाहातां दिसेना । तत्त्वें शोधितां भासेना । ब्रह्म आहे निवडेना । कांहीं केल्यां ॥ १९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देहामध्यें त्याला पाहीला जावें तर तर तो तेथें नसतो. पंचभूतांमध्येंही तो दिसत नाही, ब्रह्मरुप होऊन तो ब्रह्मामध्यें तो असतो तरी त्यास स्वरुपाहून वेगळे काढून त्यास पाहता येत नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: You understand that He is within the body yet He cannot be seen. You searched the manifest elements but He is not something that appears. That brahman is and yet He is not chosen the way you choose this created `thing' (He cannot be the known, for He is the Knower. Therefore any form of attention or knowledge has to be dropped).

owis.original: दिसतो तरी देहधारी । परी कांहींच नाहीं अंतरीं । तयास पाहातां वरिवरी । कळेना कैसा ॥ २० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: बाहेरुन तो सामान्य माणसासारखा देहधारी दिसतो. पण त्याला " मी देह आहे ही जाणीव नसते. " अशा ज्ञानी पुरुषास वरवर पाहिलें तर त्याची आंतील अवस्था ध्यानांत येणार नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: When He sees through the eyes then, there He is the holder of a body (ie. jiva, see 13. 1.24). But in truth, He is not even this `thing', for He is within this `thing'. But if you understand Him as these outer appearances then, how can He be realized?

owis.original: कळाया शोधावें अंतर । तंव तो नित्य निरंतर । जयास धुंडितां विकार । निर्विकार होती ॥ २१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तो खरा कसा आहे हे कळण्यासाठीं त्याची अंतरस्थिती शोधून पहावी. तसें केल्यावर कळतें कीं, तो सदासर्वदा शाश्वत वस्तु असतो. स्वस्वरुपाशीं तदाकार झालेला असतो. त्याचा शोध घेतां घेतां आपली देहबुद्धी नाहीशी होते. आणि आपण स्वतः निर्विकार सद्वस्तु बनतो.
owis.englishMeaning: To understand Him, you have to search this inner space for the One who is eternal and beyond this inner space. If mula maya is searched through then, this modification `I am' will become that unmodified Self that never moves.

owis.original: तो परमात्मा केवळ । तयास नाहीं मायामळ । अखंड हेतूचा विटाळ । जालाच नाहीं ॥ २२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तो शुद्ध व केवल परमात्मस्वरुप असतो. त्याच्या ठिकाणीं मायेचा मल नसतो. कोणत्याही संकल्पाचा त्यास कधींही स्पर्श होत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: That paramatma is pure knowledge (ie. no-knowledge). That has no blemish of maya. That which is unbroken has not become the impurity of this original intent.

owis.original: ऐसा जो कां योगीराज । तो आत्मा सहजीं सहज । पूर्णब्रह्म वेदबीज । देहाकारें कळेना ॥ २३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अनुभवाच्या अशा उच्च पातळीवर स्थिर राहणारा योगीराज अगदी सहजपणें आत्मस्वरुप असतो. वेदाचें मूळ असणारा आणि पूर्णब्रह्मस्वरुप झालेला तो ज्ञानी त्याच्या देहावरुन ओलखता येणें शक्य नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: That purush is the `King of yoga'. That atma is the natural within the natural (ie. there is That only, He is not required to be the witness `there'). That complete brahman is the *seed the vedas speak of, yet He cannot be understood when you hold this `all' body form. *(From this seed of the `all' the words come and the vedas were formed and a world appeared)

owis.original: देह भावितां देहचि दिसे । परी अंतर अनारिसें असे । तयास शोधितां नसे । जन्ममरण ॥ २४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देहाच्या दृष्टीनें तो सामान्य देहधारी पुरुष वाटतो. पण त्याची आंतील स्थिती अगदी निराळीच असते. तिचा शोध घेतला तर त्यास जन्ममरण नाहीं हें समजून येतें.
owis.englishMeaning: As soon as you imagine a body then, a body is seen. But truly, He is very different to this inner space even (ie. `all' body). Thus if in this way, you search for that Reality, birth and death will disappear. (maharaj- whatever you see and perceive, He is not that)

owis.original: जयास जन्ममरण व्हावें । तें तो नव्हेचि स्वभावें । नाहींच तें आणावें । कोठून कैंचें ॥ २५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अविद्येमुळें जीवपणा व जीवपणामुळें जन्ममरण. ज्ञानी पुरुषाची अविद्या व जीवपणा स्वस्वरुप साक्षात्कारानें आपोआप नाहींसें होतात. तो जीवरुप नसून परमात्मस्वरुप असतो. त्यामुळे त्यास जन्ममरण नसतें. जें नाहींच तें आणणार कोठून ?
owis.englishMeaning: Birth and death are for mula maya. But this is not the nature of that atma purush. For how can that *Reality be brought from out of nothing (this mula maya is zero; everything comes from zero, ignorance)? *(parabrahman has nothing to do with all this, He has never lost Himself and He cannot be a product of what is not/maya)

owis.original: निर्गुणास जन्म कल्पिला । अथवा निर्गुण उडविला । तरी उडाला आणी जन्मला । आपला आपण ॥ २६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ज्ञानी पुरुष निर्गुण असतो. त्यास जन्ममरण नसतें. पण अज्ञानी माणसानें निर्गुणास जन्म मरण असते अशी कल्पना केली, तरी निर्गुण जसेंच्या तसेंच राहते. ज्ञानी पुरुषाला कोणाच्या म्हणण्यानें जन्ममरण भोगावें लागत नाही. पण त्या कल्पना करणार्‍या अज्ञानी माणसासच तें भोगावें लागतें.
owis.englishMeaning: If you imagine that that nirgun can be born or that It can be struck down then, you are bringing death and birth upon Yourself (ie. caught in the claws of imagination you imagine you are and consequently will not be).

owis.original: माध्यांनीं थुंकितां सूर्यावरी । तो थुंका पडेल आपणाच वरी । दुसर्‍यास चिंतितां अंतरीं । आपणास घडे ॥ २७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: भर दुपारीं एखाद्यानें सूर्यावर थुंकण्याचा प्रयत्न केला तर तो थुंका त्याच्याच अंगावर पडतो. किंवा दुसर्‍याचे वाईट व्हावें असें आपण मनांत आणलें तर आपलेंच वाईट होते.
owis.englishMeaning: When you spit at the mid-day sun then, that spit falls on you only. In the same way, when you think that there is another then, in this inner space you have been formed (and the separateness of `I am-ness' is created).

owis.original: समर्थ रायाचें महिमान । जाणतां होतें समाधान । परंतु भुंकों लागलें स्वान । तरी तें स्वानचि आहे ॥ २८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: समजा एक कर्तृत्ववान थोर पुरुष आहे, त्याचा थोरपणा समजला म्हणजे मनाचें समाधान होते. पण त्याच्यावर भुंकणारी कुत्रीं असतात. ती भुंकली तरी ती कुत्रीच आहेत म्हणून कोणी तिकडे लक्ष देत नाहीत.
owis.englishMeaning: There is the Master and there is the power of the Master. When you know these then, there is samadhan. But when the dog starts barking (maharaj- the dog knows, "I am a dog; I am not a cat"), then that Reality has become a dog only. (This body consciousness is not any better than being a dog. It seeks only food, a female and sleep. It spends its life with its tongue out, begging for something and does not know what is vivek)

owis.original: ज्ञानी तो सत्यस्वरुप । अज्ञान देखे मनुष्यरुप । भावासारिखा फळद्रूप । देव तैसा ॥ २९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आत्मज्ञानी पुरुष परमात्मस्वरुप असतो. अज्ञानी त्याला सामान्य मनुष्य समजतात. जसा ज्याचा भाव तसा देव त्याला फलद्रुप होतो. ज्ञानी पुरुषाला जो सामान्य समजतो त्याला फलदेखिल माणसाचेंच प्राप्त होते.
owis.englishMeaning: The gnyani is that true swarup but the ignorant see a man's form.6 God appears according to whatever conviction you hold of Him.

owis.original: देव निराकार निर्गुण । लोक भाविती पाषाण । पाषाण फुटतो निर्गुण । फुटेल कैसा ॥ ३० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: खरा देव निर्गुण आहे. तसाच तो ाकाररहितही आहे. सामान्य लोक पाषाणामध्यें त्याची भाचना करतात. पाषाण तर फुटतो, निर्गुण देव फुटणें शक्य नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: God is formless and nirgun but the world gives regard to stone idols. The stone will 6 siddharameshwar maharaj- What reward should the guru give to the disciple who pays no attention to the instructions in the sadguru's discourse and fails to act accordingly? Instead, the disciple only recites "Guru brahma, guru vishnu..." and does puja with frankincense, lamp and food-offerings. Suppose a master orders a servant, "Bring some water," but the servant neglects this and instead starts dancing around and says "Oh master, what a beautiful face you have, what a fine physique, how wonderful you are." If the servant acts like this then, what reward will he get from his master? In the same way, if the disciple only makes the sadguru's puja with sweet words then, what is the use of sadguru's speech? get broken one day but, how will that nirgun ever be broken?

owis.original: देव सदोदित संचला । लोकीं बहुविध केला । परंतु बहुविध जाला । हें तों घडेना ॥ ३१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देव सगळीकडें गच्च भरुन आहे. सामान्य लोक त्याला अनेकपणानें भजतात. एकाला अनेकपण देतात. मात्र एकच एक असणारा देव अनेक होणें शक्य नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: God is ever-arisen/sado-dita and completely full but in this world, He is made into the `many' forms (ie. gross bodies and stone idols). But with the appearance of these `many' forms, that thoughtless paramatma can never be understood.

owis.original: तैसा साधु आत्मज्ञानी । बोधें पूर्ण समाधानी । विवेकें आत्मनिवेदनी । आत्मरुपी ॥ ३२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तसेंच साधु आत्मज्ञानी असतो. त्या ज्ञानानें तो संपूर्ण समाधानी असतो. निदिध्यासानें तो अनन्य होऊन आत्मस्वरुपाकार बनतो.
owis.englishMeaning: The sadhu is the atma gnyani. By understanding He has gained complete samadhan. Through vivek, He has surrendered to the atma and has become like that atma.

owis.original: जळोन काष्ठाचा आकार । अग्नि दिसे काष्ठाकार । परी काष्ठ होईल हा विचार । बोलोंच नये ॥ ३३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एखादें लाकूड जेव्हां अग्नीने जळते तेव्हां अग्नीला त्या लाकडाचा आकार प्राप्त होतो. पण अग्नी लाकूड कधींच होत नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: When a piece of wood burns then, the fire takes the shape of wood but has the fire become that wood? In the same way, that thoughtless swarup has never become this `I am'.

owis.original: कर्पूर असे तो जळतां दिसे । तैसा ज्ञानीदेह भासे । तयास जन्मवितां कैसें । कर्दळीउदरी ॥ ३४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कापूर जलतो तो जळतांना दिसतो, पण तो कर्दळीच्या पोटांत उत्पन्न होत नाही. त्याचप्रमाणें आत्मज्ञान धारण करणार्‍या ज्ञानी पुरुषाचा देह दिसतो; पण एकदा तो पतन पावला कीं ज्ञानी पुरुषास परत जन्म येत नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: The body of the gnyani is like camphor; it is seen while it is burning. It appears but it is burning away and will not remain in the end. And just as the *camphor cannot return to the plantain so too, how can that gnyani ever be made to take a birth? *(Camphor is produced from the resin of a plaintain)

owis.original: बीज भाजलें उगवेना । वस्त्र जळालें उकलेना । बोध निवडितां निवडेना । गंगेमधें ॥ ३५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: बी भाजलें कीं तें उगवत नाही. वस्त्र जळलें कीं तें उकलत नाहीं. एखदा  ओढा गंगेला मिळला कीं परत निराळा काढता येत नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: The seed that is burnt does not germinate. The cloth that is burnt cannot be picked up and the agreed upon stream cannot be agreed upon, when it enters the ganga.

owis.original: बोध गंगेमागें दिसे । गंगा येकदेसी असे । साधु कांहींच न भासे । आणी आत्मा सर्वगत ॥ ३६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ओढा गंगेला मिळण्यापूर्वी वेगळा दिसतो नंतर दिसत नाहीं. कारण गंगा एकदेशी आहे. त्यामुळें आधींचा ओढा दिसत राहतो. पण आत्मा सर्वदेसी आहे, सर्वव्यापी आहे व स्थळकाळाच्या त्याला मर्यादा नाहींत. त्यामुळें आत्मज्ञानी पुरुष एकदा का स्वरुपाकार झाला कीं वेगळा दिसत नाही. येथें गंगेची व ओढ्याचा दृष्टांत उणा पडतो.
owis.englishMeaning: The stream can be seen before it enters the ganga but afterwards it becomes one with the ganga. In the same way, the sadhu does not appear as this `thing' even, for He is the atma that pervades this `all thing'.

owis.original: सुवर्ण नव्हे लोखंड । साधूस जन्म थोतांड । अज्ञान प्राणी जडमूढ । तयास हें उमजेचिना ॥ ३७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सोनें म्हणजे सर्वोत्तम धातु तर लोखंड म्हणजे हीन धातु. त्याचप्रमाणें साधु हा सुवर्णासारखा तर अज्ञानी हा लोखंडासारखा समजावा. सामन्यांस पुन्हा पुन्हा जन्म घ्यावा लागतो. पण साधूला पुन्हा जन्म नसतो. सामान्य अज्ञानी व मूढ माणसांना हें उमजत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: The gold can never become iron again once it has been touched by the paris stone; in the same way the birth of that sadhu is merely a fictitious story. But the ignorant in the prana are gross and dull and if they see this body and say it is the sadhu then, how then will they ever understand that thoughtless Reality?

owis.original: अंधास कांहींच न दिसे । तरी ते लोक आंधळे कैसे । सन्नपातें बरळतसे । सन्नपाती ॥ ३८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आंधळ्या माणसास स्वतःला कांहींच दिसत नाहीं. म्हणून इतर सर्व माणसांना आंधळेंपणानें कांहीं दिसत नाहीं. असें म्हणता येणार नाहीं. सन्निपातज्वरामध्यें माणूस कांहींहीं बरळतो. त्याचप्रमाणें अज्ञानी माणूस साधूबद्दल कांहींहीं बडबडतो.
owis.englishMeaning: The blind cannot see this `thing'/knowledge. How then will this world of the blind and confused even understand that Reality? The ignorant's talk is no better than the wild and incoherent babblings that are caused by fever.

owis.original: जो स्वप्नामधें भ्याला । तो स्वप्नभयें वोसणाला । तें भयें जागत्याला । केवि लागे ॥ ३९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एका माणसाला भयानक स्वप्न पडलें व तत्यामुळें तो घाबरला आणि मोठ्यानें ओरडला जागा असलेल्या माणसाला तें भय वाटणार नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: When that purush gets frightened in this dream then, that atma screams out with `dream fear'. But how can fear ever affect the One who is awake?

owis.original: मुळीं सर्पाकार देखिली । येक भ्याला येकें ओळखिली । दोघांची अवस्था लेखिली । सारिखीच कैसी ॥ ४० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सर्पाचा आकार असलेली मुळी दोघांनी पाहीली. एक घाबरला तर दुसर्यानें ती मुळीं आहे हें ओळखलें. या दोघांची अवस्था सारखींच आहे असें म्हणता येत नाहीं कारण एक घाबरलेला आहे तर दुसरा निर्भय आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: The shape of the root gives the appearance of a snake and one person gets afraid while another knows there is no snake. How can the states of both be regarded as the same?7

owis.original: हातीं धरितां हि डसेना । हें येकास भासेना । तरी ते त्याची कल्पना । तयासीच बाधी ॥ ४१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ती मुळीं हातात धरली तरी चावत नाहीं हें घाबरलेल्या माणसाला पटत नाही. ती मुळी नसून सापच आहे ही त्याची कल्पनाच त्याला बाधते.
owis.englishMeaning: Even if held in the hand or kept in one's possession still, it can never bite.8 In the same way, that thoughtless Reality cannot appear to the one who sees this illusion. When that Reality imagines Its own self then, pain and suffering come to that Reality.

owis.original: विंचु सर्प डसला । तेणें तोचि जाकळला । तयाचेनि लोक जाला । कासावीस कैसा ॥ ४२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ज्या मानसाला साप किंवा विंचू चावतो, त्यालाच तें वीष बाधून तो कासावीस होतो. त्या वीषानें इतर लोक कासावीस होत नाहीत.
owis.englishMeaning: When the scorpions and snakes bite (ie. desires) then, that one who is truly paramatma, gets tormented. But how can that Reality be distressed by the appearances of this world? (If He uses vivek then, His world will be this `all'/knowledge. And when He usues further vivek then, He understands that this too, is false)

owis.original: आतां तुटला अनुमान । ज्ञानियास कळे ज्ञान । अज्ञानास जन्ममरण । चुकेचिना ॥ ४३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आतां श्रोत्यानें काढलेल्या शंकेचें निरसन झालें. जो स्वतः ज्ञानी असतो त्यालाच ज्ञानी पुरुषाची अवस्था आकलन होतें. जो अज्ञानी असतो त्याचे मात्र जन्ममरण चुकत नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: Now with understanding of this `all', the conjecture has been broken and then the gnyani understands that pure knowledge. However, the ignorant cannot avoid birth and death.

owis.original: येका जाणण्यासाठीं । लोक पडिले अटाटीं । नेणपणें हिंपुटी होती । जन्ममृत्यें ॥ ४४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपणास ज्ञान व्हावें यासाठीं लोक खटपट करीत असतात. पण अज्ञानामुळें त्यांचे जन्ममृत्यु कांहीं चुकत नाहीत. त्यामुळें त्यांना दुःख भोगावें लागतें.
owis.englishMeaning: That One, on account of this knowing, will fall in this world of the `all' and then, will objectify further and see a world of `many' names and forms. And due to His ignorance/not knowing, He will get drowned in births and deaths.

owis.original: तेंचि कथानुसंधान । पुढें केलें परिछिन्न । सावधान सावधान । म्हणे वक्ता ॥ ४५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: हाच विषय पुढें अगदी स्पष्ट करुन सांगितला आहे. म्हणून श्रोत्यांनी फार लक्ष द्यावें. अशी वक्ता विनंती करतो.
owis.englishMeaning: If that Reality accepts this connection to this `story' of the `all then, afterwards It will get divided out into numerous different forms. Therefore the speaker/Master says, "Be alert, be ever alert." .

source.name: Stotra (hymns) blog by Prakash Ketkar (ioustotra.blogspot.com) — original owi text and Marathi meaning

englishSource.name: Dasbodh, English translation by John Norwell (2015)

owis.original: पृथ्वीमधें लोक सकळ । येक संपन्न येक दुर्बळ । येक निर्मळ येक वोंगळ । काय निमित्य ॥ १ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: या पृथ्वीवर असंख्य माणसें आहेत. त्यांपैकी कांहीं गरीब तर कांहीं श्रीमंत आहेत. कांहीं घाणेरडी तर कांहीं निर्मळ, स्वच्छ आहेत. असा फरक असण्याचे कारण काय ?
owis.englishMeaning: "Within this gross elemental earth there is this world of the `all'. What is the reason for one being endowed with this great wealth of the `all' and the other being powerless due to body consciousness? What is the reason that one is pure and the other is impure?" (There are these two worlds. The world of the `all' and the world of the `many'. And within these two worlds there is that One atma)

owis.original: कित्येक राजे नांदती । कित्येक दरिद्र भोगिती । कितीयेकांची उत्तम स्थिती । कित्येक अधमोद्धम ॥ २ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कांहीं माणसें राजवैभव भोगतात तर कांहीं दारिद्र्य भोगतात. कित्येकांची स्थिति उत्तम असते तर कित्येक हीन स्थितिंत असतात.
owis.englishMeaning: "That One who is within the `many' rules as the King or that One within the `many' suffers the misery of body consciousness. For that One within the `many' there is the highest state and for that One within the `many' there is the lowest of the low?"

owis.original: ऐसें काय निमित्य जालें । हें मज पाहिजे निरोपिलें । याचें उत्तर ऐकिलें । पाहिजे श्रोतीं ॥ ३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: माणसांमध्यें असा फरक, भेद असण्याचे कारण काय, तें आपण मला सांगावें. वक्ता म्हणतो या प्रश्र्णाचे उत्तर श्रोत्यांनी ऐकले पाहीजे.
owis.englishMeaning: "What is the reason for this and tell to `me', what is that thoughtless discourse?" The speaker says, in the listener, there should be the listening to this reply (maharaj- reply to the mind in such a way that the mind goes off).

owis.original: हे सकळ गुणापासीं गती । सगुण भाग्यश्री भोगिती । अवगुण दरिद्रप्राप्ती । येदर्थीं संदेह नाहीं ॥ ४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: हा सगळा भेद आपल्या गुणांचा परिणाम आहे. जे गुणवान असतात ते भाग्यशाली असतात व चैभव भोगतात. जे अवगुणी असतात तें दारिद्र्य भोगतात. यांत संशय नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: When that thoughtless swarup is this `all' state then, It is in the charge of the sattwa guna. It has become this sagun `experience' and enjoys good fortune. But when It accepts these inferior *gunas then, it becomes body conscious and stricken with poverty. For this reason, one should leave off these doubts that hold you in body consciousness. *(Objectification or imagination)

owis.original: जो जो जेथें उपजला । तो ते वेवसाईं उमजला । तयास लोक म्हणती भला । कार्यकर्ता ॥ ५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जो माणूस ज्या धंद्यांत जन्म घेतो. तो धंदा त्यानें जाणतेपणानें व समजून केला तर लोक त्याला चांगला म्हणतात. कार्यकर्ता मानतात.
owis.englishMeaning: When that purush gets born `here' in mula maya then, it is understood to be a `doer'. Then He gets called wise, knowledgeable and capable, for He is ever engaged in doing this action of the `all' (ie. `Myself is everywhere').

owis.original: जाणता तो कार्य करी । नेणता कांहींच न करी । जाणता तो पोट भरी । नेणता भीक मागे ॥ ६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जाणता माणूस कष्ट करतो व काम करुन पोट भरतो. नेणता माणूस कांहींच करत नाही. तो आळशी असतो. त्यामुळें त्याला भीक मागावी लागते.
owis.englishMeaning: That Knower does this `all' action and those who don't know/ignorant cannot do this action of the `thing'. That Knower gets satisfied within (ie. ananda) and those who don't know have to beg (give me this and that and make me happy).

owis.original: हें तों प्रगटचि असे । जनीं पाहातां प्रत्यक्ष दिसे । विद्येवीण करंटा वसे । विद्या तो भाग्यवंत ॥ ७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: या गोष्टी अगदी उघड असल्यानें समाजांत प्रत्यक्ष अनुभवास येऊन  दिसून येतात.  विद्याहीन माणूस करंटा तर विद्यासमपन्न माणूस भाग्यवान असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: That One understands that all this is myself made manifest but when That takes birth in this world then, It sees through the sensory organs. When there is no knowledge then, that atma lives as a miserable wretch and when there is knowledge then, that atma is the possessor of good fortune.

owis.original: आपुली विद्या न सिकसी । तरी काये भीक मागसी । जेथें तेथें बुद्धी ऐसी । वडिलें सांगती ॥ ८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: " आपली विद्या शिकला नाहींस तर भीक मागावी लागेल. असा जाणतेपणानें वागण्याचा सल्ला वडिल माणसें देत असतात.
owis.englishMeaning: If you do not learn your own knowledge then, how much will you have to beg? (How can I find happiness? Please somebody or something give me some happiness) But when your buddhi `here' is `there' then, that elder, the atma, says, "I don't want nothing because nothing is true."

owis.original: वडिल आहे करंटा । आणी समर्थ होये धाकुटा । कां जे विद्येनें मोटा । म्हणोनियां ॥ ९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: दोघे भाऊ आहेत. धाकटा भाग्यवान निघाला व मोठा करंटा तर धकट्याचे भाग्य त्याच्याजवळच्या विद्येंने आलेले असते, असेंच आढळते.
owis.englishMeaning: But if that elder is a wretch and has no knowledge then, He becomes a servant. And how then can mula maya become brahman if there is this knowledge of the servant?

owis.original: विद्या नाहीं बुद्धि नाहीं । विवेक नाहीं साक्षेप नाहीं । कुशळता नाहीं व्याप नाहीं । म्हणौन प्राणी करंटा ॥ १० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: विद्या, हुषारी, विवेक, प्रयत्न, कौशल्य आणि व्याप या गुणांपैकी एकही गुण अंगी नसेल तर माणूस करंटा असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: If there is no knowledge and no buddhi; if there is no vivek and no alertness; if there is no cleverness and no pervasiveness then, He is a wretched fool in the prana.

owis.original: इतुकें हि जेथें वसे । तेथें वैभवास उणें नसे । वैभव सांडितां अपैसें । पाठीं लागे ॥ ११ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आणि हे सगळे गुण ज्याच्या अंगी असतात त्याला वैभव कधींहीं कमी पडत नाही. आणि नको म्हटलें तरी वैभव त्याच्या मागें लागते.
owis.englishMeaning: But whenever knowledge, vivek etc. are present `here' then, there is no lack of this grandeur `there'. And then even if one leaves aside this grandeur (ie. this `all'), still it will follow behind. (maharaj- knowledge runs after you, it wants to serve you)

owis.original: वडिल समर्थ धाकुटा भिकारी । ऐका याची कैसी परी । वडिलाऐसा व्याप न करी । म्हणौनियां ॥ १२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: याउलट समजा मोठा भाऊ वैभव भोगतो व धाकटा भाऊ वैभवहीन असतो याचे कारण धाकटा मोठ्यासारखा व्याप करीत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: And if the father has that understanding but His son is a beggar then, he has not been listening to His father's `speech'? The pervasiveness that is with the Father has not therefore been created by the son.

owis.original: जैसी विद्या तैसी हांव । जैसा व्याप तैसें वैभव । तोलासारिखा हावभाव । लोक करिती ॥ १३
owis.marathiMeaning: माणसाची विद्या जेवढी असेल तेवढी महत्वाकांक्षा त्यास असते. तो जेवढे व्याप करतो तेवढें वैभव त्यास मिळते. माणसाचें सामर्थ्य जेवढें असतें तितकी कर्तबगारी तो दाखवितो.
owis.englishMeaning: As is one's knowledge, so will be one's desires. As is one's pervasiveness, so will be one's glory. The actions that we make will be the same as the inclination of our mind and we will create a world accordingly (ie. either this world of `many' imaginations or this world of the pervasive `all').

owis.original: विद्या नसे वैभव नसे । तेथें निर्मळ कैंचा असे । करंटपणें वोखटा दिसे । वोंगळ आणी विकारी ॥ १४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ज्या माणसाजवळ विद्या नसते व वैभवही नसते तो मलिनपणें वावरतो. भाग्यहीन असल्यानें तो अगदी वाईट दिसतो. तसेच तो अगदी अस्वच्छ व वाईट प्रवृत्तीचा असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: When there is no knowledge then, there is no glory of this `all'. And if there is no glory then, how will there ever be the purity of `there'? Due to such wretchedness (ie. rajo guna), the filthy is seen and there is ugliness and many modifications.9

owis.original: पशु पक्षी गुणवंत । त्यास कृपा करी समर्थ । गुण नसतां जिणें वेर्थ । प्राणीमात्राचें ॥ १५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पशु व पक्षी गुणी असतील तर भाग्यवान माणूस त्यांच्यावरही कृपा करतो. पण अंगी कांहींच गुण नसतील तर माणसाचें जीवन अगदी वायां जाते.
owis.englishMeaning: Whereas the one who possesses this sattwa guna is the beast and the bird for he understands, `I am everything, everywhere' and he has received the grace of the Master. But if this guna is destroyed then, there is merely this empty living in the prana.

owis.original: गुण नाहीं गौरव नाहीं । सामर्थ्य नाहीं महत्व नाहीं । कुशलता नाहीं तर्क नाहीं । प्राणीमात्रासी ॥ १६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ज्या माणसांच्या अंगी गुण, मोठेपणा, सामर्थ्य, समाजांत महत्व नसते, कौशल्य, बुद्धिमत्ता नसते त्यांच्या जीवनांत कांहीं स्वारस्य नाहीं. अशी कांहीं माणसें असतात.
owis.englishMeaning: If this guna is not then there is no honour. Where this power is not then there is no greatness. For there is no pervasiveness and no glory for the one confined within the prana.

owis.original: याकारणें उत्तम गुण । तेंचि भाग्याचें लक्षण । लक्षणेंविण अवलक्षण । सहजचि जालें ॥ १७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: म्हणून उत्तम गुण अंगीं आणणें हेंच भाग्याचें लक्षण होय. हें लक्षण जेथें नाहीं तेथें अवलक्षण येणें हें स्वाभाविकच आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: On account of this `speech' of that superior guna, that Reality becomes this attention of the fortunate (`I am everywhere'). But without this attention of `I am', that natural thoughtless Self becomes misfortune and bad habits ("I am a body").

owis.original: जनामधें जो जाणता । त्यास आहे मान्यता । कोणी येक विद्या असतां । महत्व पावे ॥ १८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: समाजांत जाणता जो असतो त्याला लोक मानतात. ज्याच्याजवळ विद्या असते त्याला महत्व मिळते.
owis.englishMeaning: That purush is the Knower within this world and He is the only one worthy of respect. When that One who is within everyone acquires this knowledge then, He is to be considered great.

owis.original: प्रपंच अथवा परमार्थ । जाणता तोचि समर्थ । नेणता जाणिजे वेर्थ । निःकारण ॥ १९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: प्रपंचांत किंवा परमार्थांत जो जाणता असतो त्याचा प्रभाव असतो. जो नेणता असतो तो आपलें आयुष्य फुकट दवडतो.
owis.englishMeaning: Whether there is this worldly life/prapanch or paramarth still, there is that One who knows. You should understand that to not know/ignorance is void of any glory and worthless.

owis.original: नेणतां विंचु सर्प डसे । नेणतां जीवघात असे । नेणतां कार्य नासे । कोणी येक ॥ २० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अज्ञानानामुलें साप किंवा विंचु  चावण्याचा प्रसंग येतो. अज्ञानामुळें जीवाचा घात होतो. आपण करीत असलेले एखादे काम अज्ञानामुळें बिघडते.
owis.englishMeaning: The one who does not know gets bitten by scorpions and snakes (the poison of desire). The one who does not know loses this life. The one who does not know destroys this action of the moving `all'.

owis.original: नेणतां प्राणी सिंतरे । नेणपणें तर्‍हे भरे । नेणपणें ठके विसरे । पदार्थ कांहीं ॥ २१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आज्ञनामुळें माणूस भ्रमांत पडतो. अज्ञानामुळें भलत्या भरीला पडून माणूस कांहींतरी वागतो. अज्ञानामुळें माणूस फसतो व आपली वस्तु विसरतो.
owis.englishMeaning: The one who does not know is ensnared in the prana. By not knowing, one is tormented and by not knowing one is deceived and forgets this object that is this `thing'.

owis.original: नेणतां वैरी जिंकिती । नेणतां अपाई पडती । नेणतां संव्हारती घडती । जीवनास ॥ २२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपल्या अज्ञानामुळें शत्रु आपल्याला जिंकतो. अज्ञानाच्यापायीं आपल्याला नुकसान सोसावें लागते. अज्ञानामुळें संहार होतो. व जीवाचा नाश होतो.
owis.englishMeaning: The one who does not know gets conquered by the enemy (ie. ego). The one who does not know makes mistakes and suffers great lose. The one who does not know destroys everything and destroys this life.

owis.original: आपुलें स्वहित न कळे जना । तेणें भोगिती यातना । ज्ञान नेणतां अज्ञाना । अधोगती ॥ २३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अज्ञानामुळें माणसाला स्वहीत कळत नाही. त्यामुळें त्याला यातना भोगाव्या लागताता. ज्ञान नसल्यानें अज्ञानी माणसाची अधोगती होते.
owis.englishMeaning: The people do not understand this which is their own Self-benefit and therefore great suffering has to be endured. If this knowledge is not known then, there is ignorance and one falls down into the body and stays so very far away from the Self.

owis.original: मायाब्रह्म जीवशिव । सारासार भावाभाव । जाटिल्यासाठीं होतें वाव । जन्ममरण ॥ २४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: माया व ब्रह्म, जीव व शीव, सार व असार यांचें बरोबर ज्ञान झाले म्हणजे जन्ममरण नाहींसे होते.
owis.englishMeaning: Only through detachment will one come to understand maya and brahman, the jiva and shiva; the essence and non-essence and existence and non-existence, and then birth and death are made void.

owis.original: कोण कर्ता निश्र्चयेंसीं । बद्ध मोक्ष तो कोणासी । ऐसें जाणतां प्राणीयासी । सुटिकां घडे ॥ २५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: खरा कर्ता कोण आहे ? बंध व मोक्ष कोणास घडतो ? याचें निश्र्चित ज्ञान झालें कीं माणसाच्या सुटका होते तो मुक्त होतो.
owis.englishMeaning: When you know who is truly the doer and who is bound and who is liberated then, you are released from within the prana.

owis.original: जाणिजे देव निर्गुण । जाणिजे मी तो कोण । जाणिजे अनन्यलक्षण । म्हणिजे मुक्त ॥ २६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देव निर्गुण आहे याचें ज्ञान करुन घ्यावे. मी कोण आहे याचे ज्ञान करुन घ्यावें. मी आणी देव एकरुपच आहोत हें ज्ञान करुन घ्यावें म्हणजें माणूस मुक्त होतो.
owis.englishMeaning: That nirgun God should be known; one should know, who am I? and who is God? One should know that `no-otherness' and that only should be called Liberation.

owis.original: जितुकें जाणोन सांडिलें । तितुकें दृश्य वोलांडिलें । जाणत्यास जाणतां तुटले । मूळ मीपनाचे ॥ २७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ज्ञान व्यवहारांत जितकें कांहीं जाणलें आणि मिथ्या म्हणून बाजूस सारलें तितकें दृश्य ओलांडलें असें समजावें. अखेर सर्व जाणणारा जो आत्मा त्याला जाणलें कीं मीपणाचें मूळ नाहींसे होते.
owis.englishMeaning: When whatever is known is let slip away and whatever is visible is left behind then, you are the Knower and the root of `I am-ness' is dissolved.

owis.original: न जाणतां कोटीवरी । साधनें केलें परोपरीं । तरी मोक्षाचा अधिकारी । होणार नाहीं ॥ २८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अशा रीतीनें जाणत्याला न जाणतां, करोडों साधनें नाना प्रकारानें केली तरी कोणी मोक्षाचा अधिकारी होणार नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: The one who does not know up to that pure knowledge may do many kinds of sadhana, but still he will not be worthy of Final Liberation.

owis.original: मायाब्रह्म वोळखावें । आपणास आपण जाणावें । इतुक्यासाठीं स्वभावें । चुके जन्म ॥ २९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: माया आणी ब्रह्म कसें तें जाणावें, आपणच "मी कोण" याचें ज्ञान करुन घ्यावें  म्हणजे माणूस मुक्त होतो.
owis.englishMeaning: maya and brahman should be recognized. You should know your Self. And on account of this, birth will naturally be avoided.

owis.original: जाणतां समर्थाचें अंतर । प्रसंगें वर्ते तदनंतर । भाग्य वैभव अपार । तेणेचि पावे ॥ ३० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: प्रथम भगवंताच्या खर्‍या स्वरुपाचें ज्ञान करुन घ्यावें. त्यानंतर व्यवहारांतील प्रसंग ओळखून वर्तन करावें. असें केल्यानें फार मोठे भाग्य व वैभव वाट्यास येईल.
owis.englishMeaning: When you know the inner space of the Master and afterwards, exist and function through His knowledge then, you are truly blessed and acquire the glory of that limitless swarup.

owis.original: म्हणौन जाणणें नव्हे सामान्य । जाणतां होईजे सर्वमान्य । कांहींच नेणतां अमान्य । सर्वत्र करिती ॥ ३१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: म्हणून ज्ञान हें सामान्य समजूं नये. ज्ञानी माणसाला सर्व लोक मानतात. जो कांहींच जाणत नाहीं अशा अज्ञानी माणसाला कोणीच मानीत नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: Therefore, to know is not nirgun (ie. He does not know even). The One who knows has respect for this `all' and the One who does not know has no respect for this `thing' at all.

owis.original: पदार्थ देखोन भूत भावी । नेणतें झडपोन प्राण ठेवी । मिथ्या आहे उठाठेवी । जाणते जाणती ॥ ३२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एका अज्ञानी माणसानें अंधारांत कांहीं बघितलें तें भूत आहे  अशा प्रकारे खोट्या कल्पनेनें झपाटून तो प्राणास मुकला.  हा सगळा खेळ अज्ञानाच्यामुळें निर्माण झालेल्या खोट्या कल्पनेचा आहे. ही गोष्ट जाणते लोक ओळखतात.
owis.englishMeaning: Though we are actually seeing by means of this `thing' still, the one who does not know this conceives of `many' objects and being possessed of the elements gets placed in the prana. But the Knower knows these elements are false and the source of only troubles and toil.

owis.original: जाणत्यास कळे वर्म । नेणत्याचें खोटे कर्म । सकळ कांहीं धर्माधर्म । जाणतां कळे ॥ ३३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जाणत्याला रहस्य कळतें. नेणत्याचें कर्म खोटें असतें. तो चुकीचें कर्म करतो. धर्म कोणता व अधर्म कोणता हें जाणत्याला सर्व कळतें.
owis.englishMeaning: To the One who knows, there comes the understanding of that thoughtless essence. And to the One who does not know there comes, his false karma. The Knower, He understands the difference between dharma and adharma and perceives this `all thing'. (He realizes that one's inherent nature or dharma is to stay in this `I am' or effortless knowing and so drops everything; all thoughts from His mind)

owis.original: नेणत्यास येमयातना । जाणत्यास कांहींच लागेना । सकळ जाणोन विवंचना । करी तो मुक्त ॥ ३४ ॥
